adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration builds raw SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"` where `h` comes from the legacy `site_settings` value split by newlines. Because `h` is not escaped/sanitized, any host line containing a single quote (or other SQL-special characters) will produce invalid SQL and can abort the migration (and potentially allows SQL injection if the stored setting was maliciously crafted). This is directly verifiable from the diff.
